Fat
As for other nutrients, the AI for fat intake is based on the average intake of fat from human milk alone or in addition to comple-
mentary foods after 7 months of age (Table 2). Although infant formulas are designed to contain a percentage of energy as fat
similar to human milk (approximately 50%), the type of fat in formulas varies widely, including sources such as safﬂower,
sunﬂower, soybean oil, and coconut and palm oils, usually in some combination.
